cmd:
echo "--- old file:"; cat /tmp/tts_samples.py | head -c 300; echo; echo "--- old log:"; tail -3 /tmp/tts_samples.log
pkill -f tts_samples.py; sleep 1
echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/tts_samples.py
python3 -m py_compile /tmp/tts_samples.py && echo script-ok; wc -l /tmp/tts_samples.py
nohup bash -c '[ -x /opt/silero-venv/bin/pip ] || python3 -m venv --system-site-packages /opt/silero-venv; /opt/silero-venv/bin/pip install -q torch numpy && cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo && /opt/silero-venv/bin/python /tmp/tts_samples.py' > /tmp/tts_samples.log 2>&1 &
sleep 3; echo started; ls /opt/silero-venv/bin | head -5
